description: Deep Learning — From perceptrons to distributed training

topics.name: Neural Networks: Perceptron and MLP
topics.prompt: lets talk about the perceptron model, single layer perceptron limitations XOR problem, multi-layer perceptron MLP, universal approximation theorem, and depth vs width tradeoffs

topics.name: Deep Learning: Activation Functions
topics.prompt: activation functions in neural networks, sigmoid, tanh, ReLU, Leaky ReLU, ELU, SELU, GELU, Swish, Mish, dying ReLU problem, and how to choose activation functions

topics.name: Machine Learning: Loss Functions
topics.prompt: loss functions in deep learning, MSE MAE, binary cross-entropy, categorical cross-entropy, focal loss for imbalanced classes, hinge loss, contrastive loss, triplet loss, and when to use each.

topics.name: Neural Networks: Backpropagation
topics.prompt: backpropagation algorithm, chain rule of calculus applied to neural networks, computational graph, forward pass, backward pass, gradient flow, and manual backprop derivation for 2-layer network.

topics.name: Machine Learning: Vanishing and Exploding Gradients
topics.prompt: vanishing gradient problem, exploding gradient problem, causes with sigmoid and deep networks, solutions: ReLU, residual connections, gradient clipping, and proper weight initialization.

topics.name: Neural Networks: Weight Initialization
topics.prompt: weight initialization strategies, Xavier Glorot initialization, He initialization, why zero initialization fails, orthogonal initialization, and impact on training convergence.

topics.name: Machine Learning: SGD and Momentum
topics.prompt: stochastic gradient descent, mini-batch SGD, batch size effects, momentum optimizer, Nesterov accelerated gradient, and learning rate selection.

topics.name: Neural Networks: Adam and Adaptive Optimizers
topics.prompt: adaptive optimizers, AdaGrad, RMSProp, Adam, AdamW decoupled weight decay, LAMB for large batch training, LARS, and comparison of optimizer convergence properties.

topics.name: Machine Learning: Learning Rate Schedules
topics.prompt: learning rate schedules, step decay, exponential decay, cosine annealing, warmup, cyclic learning rate, one-cycle policy, and how learning rate affects convergence and generalization.

topics.name: Neural Networks: Gradient Clipping and Accumulation
topics.prompt: gradient clipping by norm vs by value, gradient accumulation for large effective batch sizes, gradient scaling for mixed precision, and SAM sharpness-aware minimization.

topics.name: Machine Learning: Regularization Techniques
topics.prompt: regularization in deep learning, L1 L2 weight regularization, dropout standard spatial DropConnect DropBlock, weight decay, early stopping, and label smoothing.

topics.name: Neural Networks: Batch Normalization
topics.prompt: batch normalization, internal covariate shift, how BatchNorm works training vs inference, running mean and variance, affine parameters, and why BatchNorm accelerates training.

topics.name: Machine Learning: Layer Group Instance Normalization
topics.prompt: layer normalization for transformers, group normalization, instance normalization for style transfer, comparison of normalization techniques, and when to use each.

topics.name: Neural Networks: Data Augmentation
topics.prompt: data augmentation for deep learning, geometric transforms, color augmentation, mixup, cutout, CutMix, RandAugment, AutoAugment, and augmentation strategies for different domains.

topics.name: Machine Learning: Convolution Operation
topics.prompt: convolution operation in neural networks, 1D 2D 3D convolution, kernel filters, padding valid same, stride, dilation atrous convolution, and feature map size calculation.

topics.name: Neural Networks: Depthwise Separable Convolution
topics.prompt: depthwise separable convolution, depthwise convolution, pointwise convolution, parameter reduction, computational savings, and why MobileNet uses separable convolutions.

topics.name: Machine Learning: Pooling and Transposed Convolution
topics.prompt: pooling layers max pooling average pooling global average pooling, transposed convolution for upsampling, checkerboard artifacts, and sub-pixel convolution.

topics.name: Neural Networks: LeNet AlexNet VGGNet
topics.prompt: evolution of CNN architectures, LeNet-5 for digits, AlexNet breakthrough in ImageNet, VGGNet deep stacking of 3x3 convolutions, and key insights from each architecture.

topics.name: Machine Learning: GoogLeNet and Inception
topics.prompt: GoogLeNet Inception v1, inception module multiple kernel sizes, 1x1 convolution for dimensionality reduction, Inception v2 v3 v4, and factorized convolutions.

topics.name: Neural Networks: ResNet and Skip Connections
topics.prompt: ResNet residual networks, skip connections identity mapping, residual learning, ResNet-50 101 152, bottleneck blocks, ResNeXt grouped convolutions, and why residual connections solve degradation.

topics.name: Machine Learning: DenseNet and EfficientNet
topics.prompt: DenseNet dense connections, feature reuse, DenseNet growth rate, EfficientNet compound scaling width depth resolution, and EfficientNet-B0 to B7 scaling.

topics.name: Neural Networks: MobileNet
topics.prompt: MobileNet v1 depthwise separable, MobileNet v2 inverted residuals linear bottleneck, MobileNet v3 NAS-based architecture, and deployment on mobile devices.

topics.name: Machine Learning: Vanilla RNN
topics.prompt: recurrent neural networks, hidden state, unfolding through time, backpropagation through time BPTT, vanishing gradient in RNNs, and limitations for long sequences.

topics.name: Neural Networks: LSTM
topics.prompt: LSTM long short-term memory, cell state, forget gate, input gate, output gate, gate equations, how LSTM solves vanishing gradient, and peephole connections.

topics.name: Machine Learning: GRU
topics.prompt: GRU gated recurrent unit, update gate, reset gate, comparison with LSTM fewer parameters, bidirectional RNN, deep RNN stacking layers, and when to choose GRU vs LSTM.

topics.name: Neural Networks: Sequence to Sequence
topics.prompt: seq2seq encoder-decoder architecture, teacher forcing, beam search decoding, greedy decoding, and limitations of fixed-length context vector leading to attention.

topics.name: Machine Learning: Attention Mechanism
topics.prompt: attention mechanism, Bahdanau additive attention, Luong multiplicative attention, attention weights visualization, context vector computation, and how attention solves long-range dependencies.

topics.name: Neural Networks: Transformer Self-Attention
topics.prompt: transformer architecture, self-attention Q K V computation, scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, why scaling by sqrt(d_k), and attention complexity O(n^2).

topics.name: Machine Learning: Transformer Architecture
topics.prompt: full transformer architecture, encoder and decoder stacks, positional encoding sinusoidal vs learned, masked self-attention in decoder, cross-attention, layer norm placement pre vs post norm, and feed-forward network.

topics.name: Neural Networks: Positional Encoding
topics.prompt: positional encodings, sinusoidal positional encoding, learned positional embeddings, RoPE rotary position embedding, ALiBi, relative position encoding, and why position information is needed.

topics.name: Machine Learning: BERT
topics.prompt: BERT bidirectional encoder representations from transformers, masked language model MLM, next sentence prediction NSP, pre-training and fine-tuning paradigm, and BERT variants RoBERTa ALBERT DistilBERT.

topics.name: Neural Networks: GPT Architecture
topics.prompt: GPT generative pre-trained transformer, autoregressive language modeling, causal self-attention, GPT-2 GPT-3 scaling, in-context learning, and decoder-only vs encoder-decoder tradeoffs.

topics.name: Machine Learning: FlashAttention
topics.prompt: FlashAttention v1 and v2, tiling strategy, online softmax, IO-aware algorithm, memory efficiency, recomputation in backward pass, and FlashAttention v3 improvements.

topics.name: Neural Networks: Efficient Attention Variants
topics.prompt: multi-query attention MQA, grouped-query attention GQA, sliding window attention, sparse attention BigBird Longformer, linear attention Performer, and ring attention for long sequences.

topics.name: Machine Learning: KV Cache and Paged Attention
topics.prompt: KV cache in autoregressive inference, memory growth with sequence length, paged attention in vLLM, continuous batching, and techniques to reduce KV cache memory.

topics.name: Neural Networks: Tokenization
topics.prompt: tokenization for LLMs, byte-pair encoding BPE, WordPiece, SentencePiece, unigram model, vocabulary size tradeoffs, and how tokenization affects model performance.

topics.name: Machine Learning: Scaling Laws
topics.prompt: neural scaling laws, Kaplan scaling laws, Chinchilla optimal compute allocation, loss vs parameters vs data, and implications for training large models efficiently.

topics.name: Neural Networks: RLHF
topics.prompt: RLHF reinforcement learning from human feedback, reward model training, PPO proximal policy optimization for LLM alignment, KL penalty, and limitations of RLHF.

topics.name: Machine Learning: DPO
topics.prompt: DPO direct preference optimization, bypassing reward model, Bradley-Terry preference model, DPO loss derivation, comparison with RLHF, and practical advantages of DPO.

topics.name: Neural Networks: Fine-Tuning and LoRA
topics.prompt: fine-tuning strategies, full fine-tuning, LoRA low-rank adaptation, QLoRA quantized LoRA, prefix tuning, adapter layers, prompt tuning, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning comparison.

topics.name: Machine Learning: RAG
topics.prompt: RAG retrieval-augmented generation, document retrieval, embedding similarity search, vector databases, chunking strategies, and RAG vs fine-tuning tradeoffs.

topics.name: Neural Networks: Autoencoders
topics.prompt: autoencoders, encoder decoder bottleneck, denoising autoencoder, variational autoencoder VAE, reparameterization trick, ELBO loss, beta-VAE, and VQ-VAE vector quantized.

topics.name: Machine Learning: GANs
topics.prompt: generative adversarial networks, generator discriminator minimax game, DCGAN, WGAN Wasserstein distance, WGAN-GP gradient penalty, mode collapse, and training instability solutions.

topics.name: Neural Networks: StyleGAN
topics.prompt: StyleGAN architecture, mapping network, adaptive instance normalization AdaIN, style mixing, progressive growing, StyleGAN2 improvements, and truncation trick.

topics.name: Machine Learning: Diffusion Models
topics.prompt: diffusion models, DDPM denoising diffusion probabilistic models, forward diffusion process, reverse denoising process, noise schedules, DDIM faster sampling, and score-based models.

topics.name: Neural Networks: Latent Diffusion and Stable Diffusion
topics.prompt: latent diffusion models, encoding to latent space, Stable Diffusion architecture, classifier-free guidance, text conditioning with CLIP, and image generation quality vs speed tradeoffs.

topics.name: Machine Learning: Object Detection
topics.prompt: object detection, R-CNN Fast R-CNN Faster R-CNN, region proposal network RPN, anchor boxes, YOLO single-shot detection, SSD, RetinaNet focal loss, DETR transformer-based, and mAP evaluation.

topics.name: Neural Networks: Semantic and Instance Segmentation
topics.prompt: semantic segmentation, FCN fully convolutional network, U-Net skip connections, DeepLab atrous convolution, instance segmentation Mask R-CNN, panoptic segmentation, and IoU metrics.

topics.name: Machine Learning: Vision Transformers
topics.prompt: Vision Transformer ViT, image patch embedding, class token, DeiT data-efficient image transformers, Swin Transformer hierarchical shifted windows, and CNN vs ViT comparison.

topics.name: Neural Networks: NLP Tasks
topics.prompt: NLP tasks, text classification, named entity recognition NER, POS tagging, dependency parsing, semantic similarity, machine translation, summarization, question answering, and sentiment analysis.

topics.name: Machine Learning: Data Parallelism DDP
topics.prompt: distributed data parallelism DDP, gradient all-reduce, synchronized SGD, ring all-reduce algorithm, gradient compression, and PyTorch DistributedDataParallel.

topics.name: Neural Networks: Model and Tensor Parallelism
topics.prompt: model parallelism, tensor parallelism Megatron-LM column and row parallel, pipeline parallelism GPipe PipeDream micro-batches, and 3D parallelism combining all three.

topics.name: Machine Learning: ZeRO Optimization
topics.prompt: ZeRO zero redundancy optimizer, ZeRO stage 1 optimizer states, stage 2 gradients, stage 3 parameters, FSDP fully sharded data parallel, and memory savings at each stage.

topics.name: Neural Networks: Mixed Precision Training
topics.prompt: mixed precision training, FP16 vs BF16 vs FP32, loss scaling, gradient scaling, FP8 training, and how mixed precision reduces memory and increases throughput.

topics.name: Machine Learning: Quantization
topics.prompt: model quantization, post-training quantization PTQ, quantization-aware training QAT, INT8 INT4 quantization, GPTQ, AWQ, and accuracy vs inference speed tradeoffs.

topics.name: Neural Networks: Pruning and Distillation
topics.prompt: model pruning, structured vs unstructured pruning, magnitude pruning, lottery ticket hypothesis, knowledge distillation, teacher-student training, and DistilBERT example.

topics.name: Machine Learning: GPU Programming for DL
topics.prompt: GPU architecture for deep learning, CUDA cores, tensor cores, streaming multiprocessors, GPU memory hierarchy, memory coalescing, occupancy, and Triton GPU kernel language.

topics.name: Neural Networks: TensorRT and ONNX
topics.prompt: TensorRT inference optimization, operator fusion, kernel auto-tuning, ONNX open neural network exchange, ONNX runtime, model export and interoperability.

topics.name: Machine Learning: Mixture of Experts
topics.prompt: mixture of experts MoE, gating network, top-k routing, load balancing loss, expert parallelism, sparse MoE advantages, Switch Transformer, and Mixtral architecture.

topics.name: Neural Networks: State Space Models
topics.prompt: state space models for sequences, S4 structured state spaces, Mamba selective state space model, hardware-aware algorithm, comparison with transformers for long sequences, and H3 architecture.

topics.name: Machine Learning: Graph Neural Networks
topics.prompt: graph neural networks, message passing framework, GCN graph convolutional network, GAT graph attention network, GraphSAGE sampling, over-smoothing problem, and applications.

topics.name: Neural Networks: Multimodal Models
topics.prompt: multimodal AI, CLIP contrastive language-image pretraining, DALL-E, Flamingo visual language model, LLaVA, and how vision and language modalities are aligned.

topics.name: Deep Backpropagation: Softmax with Cross-Entropy Gradient Derivation
topics.prompt: derive analytical partial derivatives of cross-entropy loss with respect to pre-activation softmax inputs, separating target vs non-target classes

topics.name: Deep Backpropagation: Layer Normalization Backward Pass Math
topics.prompt: derive backward pass gradients for Layer Normalization, explaining mean/variance derivative paths and input feature dependencies

topics.name: Deep Backpropagation: Gated RNN Vanishing Gradient Pathways
topics.prompt: analyze backward pass gradient routes in LSTMs and GRUs, showing how additive cell state transitions prevent exponential decay

topics.name: Attention Mechanisms: Multi-Head Self-Attention Projection Sizes
topics.prompt: explain Scaled Dot-Product Attention, Multi-Head projection matrix shapes (W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o), and relative memory footprints

topics.name: Attention Mechanisms: Rotary Positional Embedding (RoPE) Mathematical Formulations
topics.prompt: explain Rotary Positional Embedding (RoPE), 2D vector rotation matrices, and relative position tracking in Multi-Head attention

topics.name: Optimization Tricks: Layer-wise Adaptive Rate Scaling (LARS)
topics.prompt: explain Layer-wise Adaptive Rate Scaling (LARS), compute layer-wise local learning rates based on weight and gradient norms for large batch training

topics.name: Optimization Tricks: Weight Decay vs L2 Regularization in AdamW
topics.prompt: explain why decoupling weight decay from gradient updates (AdamW) differs from standard L2 regularization in adaptive optimizers

topics.name: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) with Differentiable Architecture Parameters
topics.prompt: Let's implement a differentiable NAS pipeline where we replace the discrete architecture selection with continuous relaxation (e.g., Gumbel-Softmax) to optimize both weights and architecture jointly. How would you modify the gradient computation to handle this relaxation? Can you derive the gradient for the architecture parameters when using a softmax over operations like convolution, max-pooling, or identity?

topics.name: Transformers with Adaptive Sparse Attention via Routing Networks
topics.prompt: Design a transformer layer where attention heads are dynamically routed through a lightweight neural network (e.g., a 2-layer MLP) that predicts which tokens to attend to, reducing the O(N^2) complexity. How would you ensure gradient flow through the routing decisions? Can you implement a top-k routing mechanism where only the top-2 heads per token are activated during training?

topics.name: Deep Equilibrium Models (DEQs) for Sequence Modeling
topics.prompt: Implement a DEQ-based language model where the hidden state is defined as the fixed point of an implicit layer (e.g., F(h, x) = h). How would you compute gradients through this fixed point using the implicit function theorem? Can you derive the Jacobian-free backward pass for a DEQ with 10,000 iterations of fixed-point iteration?

topics.name: Diffusion Models with Learned Noise Schedules
topics.prompt: Instead of using a fixed noise schedule (e.g., linear or cosine), let's train a neural network to predict the optimal noise schedule for a diffusion model. How would you parameterize the schedule (e.g., as a learnable spline or MLP)? Can you implement a differentiable loss that penalizes both the denoising error and the KL divergence between the learned and target distributions?

topics.name: Hypernetworks for Meta-Learning with Weight Generation Constraints
topics.prompt: Design a hypernetwork that generates weights for a target model (e.g., a CNN for image classification) but enforces constraints like low-rank factorization or sparsity. How would you enforce these constraints during the weight generation process? Can you implement a hypernetwork that generates weights for a ResNet-50 while ensuring the generated weights have a rank <= 32?

topics.name: Differentiable Architecture Search (DARTS) with Gradient-Based Optimization
topics.prompt: Implement the DARTS algorithm from scratch to optimize both weights and architecture parameters on the CIFAR-100 dataset. Discuss how the bilevel optimization problem (training vs. validation loss) is solved using alternating gradient descent steps. Compare the performance of the learned cell structures against manually designed architectures like ResNet-56.

topics.name: Transformer-XL for Long-Range Sequence Modeling with Segment-Level Recurrence
topics.prompt: Reimplement the Transformer-XL architecture and train it on the PG-19 dataset (long-form text) to empirically verify the segment-level recurrence mechanism. Analyze how the relative positional encoding and adaptive attention span improve perplexity over vanilla Transformers. Benchmark against a baseline LSTM model on sequence lengths of 1024 tokens.

topics.name: Neural ODEs for Irregularly Sampled Time-Series with GRU-ODE-Bayes
topics.prompt: Derive the continuous-depth GRU-ODE-Bayes model and implement it to handle irregularly sampled medical time-series data (e.g., MIMIC-III). Compare its performance against discrete RNN variants (GRU-D) in terms of both reconstruction error and downstream classification. Discuss the computational trade-offs of solving the ODE numerically vs. analytically.

topics.name: Federated Learning with Differential Privacy via Gradient Clipping and Noise Addition
topics.prompt: Deploy a federated learning system using TensorFlow Federated to train a ResNet-18 on the FEMNIST dataset while enforcing ε-differential privacy. Implement gradient clipping (max norm = 1.0) and add Gaussian noise (scale = 0.1) to the aggregated updates. Evaluate the trade-off between model utility (accuracy) and privacy budget (ε) across multiple client participation rates.

topics.name: GANs with Spectral Normalization and Self-Supervised Learning for Unpaired Image-to-Image Translation
topics.prompt: Build a GAN architecture for unpaired image-to-image translation (e.g., horse ↔ zebra) using spectral normalization in both the generator and discriminator. Replace the traditional cycle-consistency loss with a self-supervised contrastive loss (e.g., SimCLR) to improve feature alignment. Quantify the improvement in FID score and perceptual similarity metrics against a baseline CycleGAN.

topics.name: Differentiable Neural Computers (DNC): Memory-Augmented Architecture with Explicit Addressing
topics.prompt: Let's implement a Differentiable Neural Computer (DNC) from scratch for solving a dynamic graph traversal problem. We'll focus on the controller architecture (LSTM), memory matrix operations (read/write heads with content and location-based addressing), and temporal memory linkage. Start by deriving the differentiable attention mechanisms (cosine similarity + sharpening) and implement the memory update equations. How would you modify the architecture to handle sparse memory access patterns?

topics.name: Self-Supervised Learning for 3D Point Cloud Segmentation: Contrastive Grouping with Spatial Transformers
topics.prompt: Design a self-supervised pretext task for 3D point cloud segmentation using contrastive learning. Implement a Spatial Transformer Network (STN) to learn canonical transformations that align point clouds before and after augmentation. Define the loss function to maximize agreement between transformed and original views while enforcing geometric consistency. How would you adapt the architecture to work with variable point densities?

topics.name: Neural ODEs for Continuous-Time Reinforcement Learning: Hamiltonian-Based Policy Gradients
topics.prompt: Implement a Hamiltonian Neural ODE (HODEN) to model continuous-time dynamics in a reinforcement learning environment. Define the Hamiltonian energy function to encode physical constraints and derive the policy gradient updates using the symplectic Euler method. Compare the performance of Hamiltonian ODEs against standard Neural ODEs in a MuJoCo locomotion task. What are the numerical stability challenges when solving the ODE backward in time?

topics.name: Sparse Attention Mechanisms in Vision Transformers: Multi-Scale Deformable Attention for High-Resolution Images
topics.prompt: Implement a multi-scale deformable attention module for vision transformers to process high-resolution images efficiently. Derive the sampling offsets and modulation scalars for deformable attention and integrate them into a Swin Transformer variant. Optimize the attention computation to run in O(HW) time per head. How would you handle the non-uniform sampling distribution when computing gradients through the offset predictions?

topics.name: Adversarial Robustness in GANs: Wasserstein Distance Minimization with Gradient Penalty in High-Dimensional Spaces
topics.prompt: Formulate the WGAN-GP (Wasserstein GAN with Gradient Penalty) objective and derive the gradient penalty term for high-dimensional data. Implement a critic network with spectral normalization and analyze the spectral properties of the Jacobian matrix. Experiment with different gradient penalty weights and study their effect on mode collapse. What are the numerical challenges when computing the Jacobian in high dimensions?
